purpose: Diagnose sampler-budget and prior sensitivity, not select a winner on the official test.
reference: Same fixed indices from the existing default 1000-iteration full run
model: Original R bsts LLT + harmonic seasonal52 K4, unchanged
regularization: Existing regularized mode: SdPrior(0.01*training_sd, sample.size=32) for all state innovations; observational prior unchanged
pass_rule: Every monitored parameter/final level/slope: Rhat<=1.01 and bulk/tail ESS>=400. Predictive diagnostics separate; no claiming unmonitored states converge.
decision: Run both arms regardless of interim results; no test-based choice of prior, iteration count or replacement of official full leaderboard. If strict criteria still fail, document unresolved mixing; do not scale a nonconverged configuration to full benchmark.
